#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
task_root=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listindex-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin
cd "$task_root" || exit 1
task_raw=build/listindex-native
export TMPDIR="$task_root/build/listindex-tmp"
export COPPERFIN_LOCALE_DIR="$task_root/resources/locales"
task_targets=(test_prg_engine_listindex_numeric test_prg_engine_list_index_numeric
 test_prg_engine_listitem_numeric test_prg_engine_itemidtoindex_numeric
 test_prg_engine_indextoitemid_numeric test_prg_engine_selectedid_numeric
 test_prg_engine_selected_index_numeric test_prg_engine_itemdata_index_numeric
 test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_functions
 test_prg_engine_getcolor_default_numeric test_prg_engine_numeric_behavior
 test_prg_engine_int64_exact_expression test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_itemid_selectors)
task_regex='^(test_prg_engine_(listindex_numeric|list_index_numeric|listitem_numeric|itemidtoindex_numeric|indextoitemid_numeric|selectedid_numeric|selected_index_numeric|itemdata_index_numeric|getcolor_default_numeric)(_(copperfin|vfp9)_session[12])?|test_prg_engine_numeric_behavior|test_prg_engine_int64_exact_expression|test_native_test_isolation_contract|test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_itemid_selectors|test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_functions)$'
for task_compiler in gcc clang; do
 task_build="build/listindex-$task_compiler"
 if test "$task_compiler" = gcc; then
  task_cxx=g++
  task_flags=(-O0 -g0)
  unset ASAN_OPTIONS UBSAN_OPTIONS
 else
  task_cxx=clang++
  task_flags=(-O1 -g0 -fsanitize=address,undefined,float-cast-overflow -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1
  export UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1
 fi
 sha256sum -c "$task_raw/ci-expanded.sha256" > "$task_raw/ci-expanded-before-$task_compiler.log" || exit 2
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 cmake --build "$task_build" -j 1 --target "${task_targets[@]}" > "$task_raw/compile-ci-expanded-$task_compiler.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/compile-ci-expanded-$task_compiler.status"
 test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 ctest --test-dir "$task_build" -V --output-on-failure --timeout 600 -j 1 -R "$task_regex" > "$task_raw/ci-expanded-$task_compiler.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/ci-expanded-$task_compiler.status"
 date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' > "$task_raw/ci-expanded-$task_compiler.completed-at"
 sha256sum "$task_raw/ci-expanded-$task_compiler.log" > "$task_raw/ci-expanded-$task_compiler.log.sha256"
 test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
 task_libraries=()
 for task_library in cf_xbase_runtime cf_design_model cf_prg_analysis cf_runtime_text cf_vfp_assets cf_platform_profile cf_security cf_localization cf_platform_support; do
  task_libraries+=("$task_build/lib$task_library.a")
 done
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 "$task_cxx" -std=c++20 "${task_flags[@]}" -Iinclude -Itests -Isrc/runtime -x c++ tests/fixtures/vfp9-listindex-numeric/preservation-driver.cpp.txt -x none tests/test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_functions_list_controls_03.cpp "$task_build/tests/CMakeFiles/cf_prg_engine_test_support.dir/prg_engine_test_support.cpp.o" "${task_libraries[@]}" -o "$task_raw/ci-expanded-preservation-$task_compiler" > "$task_raw/compile-ci-expanded-preservation-$task_compiler.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/compile-ci-expanded-preservation-$task_compiler.status"
 test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 "$task_raw/ci-expanded-preservation-$task_compiler" > "$task_raw/ci-expanded-preservation-$task_compiler.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/ci-expanded-preservation-$task_compiler.status"
 sha256sum "$task_raw/ci-expanded-preservation-$task_compiler.log" > "$task_raw/ci-expanded-preservation-$task_compiler.log.sha256"
 test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
 sha256sum -c "$task_raw/ci-expanded.sha256" > "$task_raw/ci-expanded-after-$task_compiler.log" || exit 2
done
